_comment: Reader-facing descriptions of review modes and personas, shown on report pages. Canonical copy — the skill files under skills/bitcoin-wallet-design-review/ describe the same things for the agent running a review, but reports must not restate these in their own words or two reports on the same persona would describe her differently.

persona-walkthrough.name: Persona walkthrough
persona-walkthrough.summary: One persona moves through the flow screen by screen. Every finding is anchored to a specific screen where they would hesitate, misread, or stop — not to a general usability principle.
persona-walkthrough.excludes: Doesn't critique visual design or propose specific copy rewrites; those are separate review types.

copy-review.name: Copy review
copy-review.summary: Judges only the words on screen — headings, button labels, error messages, terminology — for clarity and consistency, and proposes the replacement wording.
copy-review.excludes: Doesn't assess flow structure, step order, or who the wallet is for.

positioning-review.name: Positioning review
positioning-review.summary: Asks who the wallet appears built for and what it is betting people choose it for, judged from the product surface itself rather than its marketing.
positioning-review.excludes: Doesn't examine step-by-step friction inside a flow, and makes no claims about the wallet's real user base.

Priya.name: Priya
Priya.summary: Downloading her first wallet. Comfortable with banking apps, but "seed phrase", "sats" and "Lightning" mean nothing to her. Cautious, and worried about losing money or being scammed.

Dave.name: Dave
Dave.summary: Years on a centralised exchange, but has never held his own keys. Knows the vocabulary, dislikes being over-explained to, and wants the wallet to prove that backup and recovery actually work.

Marisol.name: Marisol
Marisol.summary: Runs a shop and often has a customer waiting. Cares about fast invoices, a scannable QR code, and unambiguous confirmation that payment landed.
